hcg_threshold_gain.note: lowest gain of the high-conversion-gain branch; the fine grid steps by 2, which is the uncertainty.  ZWO's own published curve annotates 200 (vendor/asi585specs/) and the retired project measured 200 -- one prediction, not two, and this reproduces it.  The 'ZWO say 252' belief has no source; 252 is the ASI2600's threshold (L26)

read_noise_at_hcg.note: pair-difference sigma / sqrt(2), mean over four CFA planes (L10)

project_offset.note: smallest offset clipping under 0.1% at every gain measured; the arm steps by 5.  ZWO recommend 15 (L13)

pedestal_per_offset_unit.note: the digital term A; L27 predicts ~4.0 and gain-independent

pedestal_fit.note: pedestal = A + B * 10**(gain/200), fitted per conversion-gain branch, split at gain 200; uncertainty is the worst residual (L27)

pedestal_drift_rate.note: gain 100, offset 15, 450 frames over 15 min at -10 C

bias_exposure.note: the camera's minimum exposure, read from the Exposure control

setpoint.note: held in band for a continuous 30 s before the first frame, and every frame outside +/-0.5 C retaken rather than written; uncertainty is the band, which is also the sensor's own quantisation
